scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run slop && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.demo:sam:source: bun scripts/sam/xlsx-to-csv.ts --kind inventory --in demo/sam/source/INSTALLED_SOFTWARE.xlsx --out demo/sam/source/installed_software.csv && bun scripts/sam/xlsx-to-csv.ts --kind software --in demo/sam/source/SOFTWARE.xlsx --out demo/sam/source/software.csv && bun scripts/sam/xlsx-to-csv.ts --kind licenses --in demo/sam/source/LICENSES.xlsx --out demo/sam/source/licenses.csv
scripts.gen:api: cd server && go run ./cmd/openapi && cd .. && openapi-typescript api/openapi.json -o client/src/shared/api/schema.d.ts
